-- fantasy-console calls (fc has a built-in game engine).

mode = "play"
score = 0
px = 52
ball = {x = 60, y = 96, dx = 0.65, dy = 0 - 0.7}
bricks = {}
for row = 0, 4 do
  for col = 0, 7 do
    brick = new_sprite()
    brick.x = col * 16 + 1
    brick.y = row * 9 + 12
    table.insert(bricks, brick)
  end
end
define_sound("bounce")
define_sound("break")
define_sound("drop")

function update()
  if mode ~= "play" then
    return
  end
  if key_pressed("left") then
    px = px - 2
  end
  if key_pressed("right") then
    px = px + 2
  end
  if px < 0 then
    px = 0
  end
  if px > 104 then
    px = 104
  end
  ball.x = ball.x + ball.dx
  ball.y = ball.y + ball.dy
  if ball.x < 1 then
    ball.dx = 0 - ball.dx
  end
  if ball.x > 124 then
    ball.dx = 0 - ball.dx
  end
  if ball.y < 1 then
    ball.dy = 0 - ball.dy
  end
  if ball.y > 114 and ball.x + 3 > px and ball.x < px + 24 then
    ball.dy = 0 - ball.dy
    ball.y = 113
    play_sound("bounce")
  end
  if ball.y > 127 then
    mode = "lose"
    play_sound("drop")
  end
  hitbrick = false
  for _i, brick in ipairs(bricks) do
    if not hitbrick then
      if ball.x + 3 > brick.x and ball.x < brick.x + 14 then
        if ball.y + 3 > brick.y and ball.y < brick.y + 7 then
          hitbrick = brick
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if hitbrick then
    list_remove(bricks, hitbrick)
    ball.dy = 0 - ball.dy
    score = score + 1
    play_sound("break")
  end
  if not bricks then
    mode = "win"
  end
end

function draw()
  clear_screen("black")
  for _i, brick in ipairs(bricks) do
    draw_rect(brick.x, brick.y, 14, 7, "orange")
  end
  draw_rect(px, 118, 24, 3, "white")
  draw_rect(ball.x, ball.y, 3, 3, "white")
  write_text("score " .. tostring(score), 2, 2, "white")  -- on HUD
end

function screen_win()  -- shown while mode is "win"
  write_text("YOU WIN!", 36, 54, "yellow")  -- on HUD
  write_text("score " .. tostring(score), 38, 70, "white")  -- on HUD
end

function screen_lose()  -- shown while mode is "lose"
  write_text("GAME OVER", 32, 54, "red")  -- on HUD
  write_text("score " .. tostring(score), 38, 70, "white")  -- on HUD
end
run_game(update, draw)
